title: Hit It, Style It, Strum It Away♪

text_block_list.text:
Today is the day to search for a hobby with
Fusaichi Pandora.
Hopefully we can find something she'll
thoroughly enjoy—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hmm♪ Hmm♪ Hmmm♪
What-oh-what will we find today~♪

Umamusume are athletes,
so sports seem like a good place to start.
And if we're talking about flashy sports
that suit her tastes—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Allllriiiighty!!
(WHACK!)

text_block_list.name: Tennis Class Participants
text_block_list.text: A-Are you kidding me—?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Right? Right? Told ya I'm amazing~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Boy with a Racket
text_block_list.text:
—...That ball was fast as a bullet
train...!

text_block_list.name: Girl with a Racket
text_block_list.text:
—And right on the line,
too... That's insane...
choice_data_list: Seriously, how did you even hit that?
Seriously, how did you even hit that?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...How? ...Like,
you just relax your grip when you swing??

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Just go all squishy-soft for a split
second.
And then, BAM! Like that, y'know?
choice_data_list: I see. Let me give it a shot!
I see. Let me give it a shot!

text_block_list.text:
I toss the ball high into the air.
Focusing my attention on the ball,
I push off the ground—
choice_data_list: Alright! Relax the grip right here—

text_block_list.text: (SWOOOOSH)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Ummm... why did you, like,
throw your racket?
choice_data_list: I think I relaxed a bit too much...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —Pfft... Ahahaha! What was that?!

...As expected,
athletic activities are effortless for
her. In that case, let's try a calmer,
more mindful hobby—
an ikebana flower arrangement class.

text_block_list.name: Ikebana Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Since this is a beginner's workshop,
just have fun with it!
Alright, let us begin!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hm hm hmm~♪ Which flower should I pick~?
Oh, this one's super cute, right? Wait,
that one over there is gorgeous too~!

I choose the flowers that catch my eye from
the selection before me.
I try arranging them, but...
choice_data_list: Getting the balance right is tough...

text_block_list.name: Ikebana Instructor
text_block_list.text: Magnificent!!

text_block_list.name: Ikebana Instructor
text_block_list.text:
The rustic beauty of nature!
An embracing warmth like that of a mother!
This is true Japanese wabi-sabi!
—Simply magnificent!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think?
Whaddya thiiiiiink☆ The colors and everything
look perfect, right♪

Even to an amateur's eye,
the colors and overall balance are
flawless.
It's easy to see why the instructor is in
awe.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea you were a natural at flower
arranging too...
Pandora-chan...
you're a total genius!!
I love it so much~!!
choice_data_list: Pandora, can you teach me the tric...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Me?
...You really want advice from me?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, back at tennis,
you sent your racket flying, remember?
Are you sure about this?
Our vibes might not really match—
choice_data_list: Still, I want to make mine as beau...
Still, I want to make mine as beau...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —...Oh reeeeally?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know,
Professor Pandora doesn't go easy on anyone,
okay~?

So far,
Fusaichi Pandora has breezed through
everything.
Which means we need to throw a real curveball
at her.

And so—after training the following day,
I brought Fusaichi Pandora to a certain
location.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a band workshop~.
First we pick our instruments?
Let's see...
Hey, what are you gonna play?
choice_data_list: Hmm. I'm still debating, but...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Then let's both do guitar♪
It totally screams "band," right? Huh?
Matching pair~♡
—And so, both of us reached for guitars.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
How's that? Honestly,
practicing scales straight from a textbook
is suuuper boring~.
If it were me... tah-dah☆

text_block_list.name: Live House Owner
text_block_list.text:
What?! No way, with fingerwork like that,
you're a beginner...?
You've gotta be kidding!

Her playing technique rivals a seasoned
pro.
I already knew this would happen,
but that's precisely why—
choice_data_list: I'm not gonna let you beat me!
I'm not about to lose either!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Tee-hee, you really think you can do it~?
choice_data_list: Don't come crying to me when I blo...
Don't come crying to me when I blo...

text_block_list.text:
―And so began our days of intense
training.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, practicing hard, huh~?
Whoa, whoa, your finger slipped! See,
in times like this―

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right here, it goes STRUM-STRUM-STRUM―
and then...
VRRRR-RRR-OOOOM! Got it? Now you try!
choice_data_list: Strum, strum, strum... vrrrr-rrr-o...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay☆ Look at that,
you picked it up in no time♪
And then―

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha! You're totally keeping up with me!
Okay then, what about this~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: SKREEEEEECH! And then... BAM!?
choice_data_list: Comes the TA-DAAAH!
It's the TA-DAAAH, right?!

text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap, clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Live House Owner
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was amazing, you two! Perfect sync,
too.
Forming a two-piece band might actually be
a blast!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
!? Hear that?! We did it, we did it!!
That means we totally rocked, right?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
A band with you, huh... Aha,
might not be so bad~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! For real,
should we do it? A two-piece band!
It feels like total high school youth
vibes!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we surprise everyone with a mellow vibe?
Like an emotional ballad!
Or nah,
should we keep hype levels through the
roof?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
let's try bass or acoustic guitar too!
Since there's two of us,
layering all kinds of sounds sounds super
fun!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Maybe someday the two of us will pack out
a dome―ehehe♪

Fusaichi Pandora chats away excitedly.
Could this mean...
choice_data_list: Looks like you're officially hooke...
Looks like you're officially hooke...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Wait... was I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, wait, no,
it was fun! Really fun... yeah!
It was super fun, but...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Huuuuummm...?
